mobbin:fc2ba92b-4783-43da-92c7-8acf4f16a.summary: User opens an Ongoing unacknowledged incident, acknowledges it (owner shown), resolves it with an AI post-mortem, then reviews metadata and a timeline of acknowledge/resolve.
steal: Step 1: Problem state with Escalate + Acknowledge; green banner names who was escalated to (Alex) — who to call is explicit.
Step 2: Acknowledge stamps owner; primary action flips to Resolve.
Step 3–4: Resolve closes the loop with duration, severity/team/owner metadata, and a timestamped timeline — guided ownership path, not a help-article list.
No at-a-glance All OK on these screens — health is conveyed by incident presence and sidebar count.
mobbin:fc2ba92b-4783-43da-92c7-8acf4f16a.fit: Acknowledge → Resolve with named owner is the dashboard system-health fix path for failed room self-tests; deep device repair still hands off to Recording, while Who's on-call maps to User management / sim-tech roster.
